name: OsMA Four Colors Arrow EA
summary: This EA trades based on the OsMA (Oscillator of Moving Averages) indicator using a four-color arrow system to visualize bullish and bearish momentum shifts. It generates buy signals when OsMA turns positive from negative and sell signals when OsMA turns negative from positive, with color coding for momentum strength. The EA automates entries and exits based on these momentum crossover signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于OsMA（移动平均振荡器）指标进行交易，采用四色箭头系统来可视化多空动量转换。当OsMA从负转正时产生买入信号，从正转负时产生卖出信号，并通过颜色编码区分动量强度。EA根据这些动量交叉信号自动执行入场和出场操作。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于OsMA指标的动量转换信号进行交易。OsMA是MACD柱状图与信号线之间的差值，能够反映价格动量的变化方向和强度。入场条件为：当OsMA从负值区域穿越到正值区域时开多单，表示多头动量增强；当OsMA从正值区域穿越到负值区域时开空单，表示空头动量增强。四色箭头系统通过不同颜色区分动量的强弱程度，例如深色表示强动量、浅色表示弱动量，帮助交易者更直观地判断信号质量。出场条件通常包括反向信号出现时平仓，或通过止损/止盈参数控制退出。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户设置固定手数或基于资金的动态仓位计算。资金管理依赖于止损和止盈参数的合理设置，但整体策略缺乏对市场波动率的自适应调整机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on momentum shift signals from the OsMA indicator. OsMA represents the difference between the MACD histogram and its signal line, reflecting the direction and strength of price momentum. Entry conditions are: a buy position is opened when OsMA crosses from negative to positive territory, signaling bullish momentum acceleration; a sell position is opened when OsMA crosses from positive to negative territory, signaling bearish momentum acceleration. The four-color arrow system differentiates momentum strength through color coding — for example, darker colors indicate stronger momentum while lighter colors indicate weaker momentum, helping traders visually assess signal quality. Exit conditions typically involve closing positions when a reverse signal appears, or through configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters. Position sizing allows users to set fixed lot sizes or dynamic calculation based on account equity. Money management relies on proper stop-loss and take-profit configuration, but the overall strategy lacks adaptive volatility-based position adjustment mechanisms.

parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying orders

pros: 基于OsMA动量指标，信号逻辑清晰易懂，适合趋势行情
四色箭头系统提供直观的动量强度可视化，便于判断信号质量
参数化设计灵活，允许调整EMA周期和止损止盈以适应不同市场环境
pros_en: Based on the well-established OsMA momentum indicator with clear and understandable signal logic, suitable for trending markets
The four-color arrow system provides intuitive momentum strength visualization for better signal quality assessment
Flexible parameterized design allows adjustment of EMA periods and stop-loss/take-profit to adapt to different market conditions
cons: 单一指标策略缺乏过滤机制，在震荡行情中容易产生虚假信号
没有包含点差过滤或交易时段过滤，可能在不利条件下入场
缺乏动态仓位管理，固定手数模式无法根据市场波动率自适应调整
cons_en: Single-indicator strategy lacks filtering mechanisms, prone to false signals in ranging/choppy markets
No spread filter or trading session filter included, may enter positions under unfavorable conditions
Lacks dynamic position sizing; fixed lot mode cannot adapt to changing market volatility
improvements: 增加趋势过滤指标（如ADX或更高周期均线）以减少震荡市中的虚假信号
加入动态仓位管理模块，根据ATR或账户风险百分比自动调整手数
improvements_en: Add a trend filter indicator (such as ADX or higher timeframe moving average) to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Implement dynamic position sizing module that automatically adjusts lot size based on ATR or account risk percentage

risk_points: 单一OsMA指标在震荡行情中易产生连续虚假信号导致多次止损
缺少点差过滤机制，高点差环境下可能不合理地触发交易
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
risk_points_en: Single OsMA indicator prone to consecutive false signals in ranging markets leading to multiple stop-loss hits
No spread filter mechanism may trigger trades under high spread conditions unreasonably
Lack of new bar check may cause repeated position opening on the same bar

It generates buy signals when OsMA turns positive from negative and sell signals when OsMA turns negative from positive, with color coding for momentum strength. The EA automates entries and exits based on these momentum crossover signals.
